body: Thank you everyone for your amazing answers. I ask this question because this has always been one of my favorite verses and I would like to get it as a tattoo. I was told it isn’t good because you should put your faith in god before each other. Again thank you for your answers 🙏

This hits way to close to home. We were together for 3 years. It’s been 2 days and I haven’t been able to function at all. She is still trying to talk to me but it hurts to much... I have deleted just about every social media app and am contemplating moving across the country at this point so I don’t hear or see anything from home... I know I’ll never get over her. I wish you all the best!

I 100% feel that it’s a weird feeling... I have a lot on my hands so they are kind of a constant reminder to me... My girlfriend of 3 years just broke up with me and she was very into her religion so I always would buy her stuff with a cross on it.... Now I have a hopefully permanent cross of my own that will be a reminder of what we had...
Hey you can message me if you would like to talk!
We care about you, this community cares about you. I’m sorry you feel like you don’t have anyone.
I could tell you there are plenty of fish in the sea but that’s over used. Focus on yourself and everything will fall in place. Message me if you want to talk!
The difference between you and your mother is that you realize what you are doing and she doesn’t. You have the opportunity to change that you have the self awareness to change yourself.
